risks: model ranking does not hold across windows
only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~24% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 24): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. The series crosses zero, so percentage errors are unstable and mean-based combinations are safer than ratio-based ones. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.259), which favours a robust combination.
